user.title: Termo Solar
user.description: Entities the decision is based on. They can be changed later in Configure. Temperatures and times are set afterwards from the device's entities. It starts in simulation: the heater is not touched until you turn «Control» on.

data_description.interruptor: The plug or relay that powers the heater.
data_description.temperatura: The tank probe, in °C. With no reading the heater is never switched on.
data_description.consumo: In W or kW: everything the house uses, heater included.
data_description.periodo: State Punta/Llano/Valle (or P1/P2/P3). During the peak period the grid is never used.
data_description.laborable: On for days with time-of-use periods. On other days nothing is heated before dawn: it waits for the sun and tops up in the afternoon if needed. Without it, every day is a working day.
data_description.prevision: Solcast «Forecast today» sensor (kWh, with the half-hourly detail in its attributes). Without it, working days always heat off-peak.
data_description.soc: In %. Used to know whether surplus sun would be exported.
data_description.capacidad_bateria: In kWh; 0 if there is no battery.
data_description.red: In W or kW, positive when importing. With the contracted power, keeps the heater from tripping the limiter.
data_description.contratada: In W or kW, the one in force right now.
data_description.red_conectada: When off (power cut) the heater is not switched on.

error.misma_entidad: The same entity is used in two fields.
error.falta_pareja: Grid power and contracted power go together: set both or neither.
error.falta_soc: With a battery the charge sensor is required.
